Graceful handling of empty bytes (should not error)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, FileExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(bytes=[], config=FileExtractionConfig(), filename="empty.txt", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="text/plain")
    config = ExtractionConfig()
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
